findings.message: The Scheduler constructor is called without the repository or a committed ticket SHA lookup, so chupa/scheduler.py cannot determine whether premise_parked applies to the current committed content.
findings.paved_road: Add chupa/daemon.py to the scope fence and pass an injectable committed-ticket SHA lookup to Scheduler, wiring it through the existing git seam.
